<thought>Based on the most intense ESI peak at m/z 268.194, the neutral mass is approximately 268.17 Da. The formula that matches this mass most closely is C₁₅H₂₄O₄ (monoisotopic mass = 268.167 Da). This fits within typical mass‑spectrometric tolerance, so the molecular formula of the compound is C15H24O4.</thought>
<final_answer>C15H24O4</final_answer>
